title: The Rebel Assault
description: Led by Admiral Ackbar of the Mon Calamari species, the Rebel Alliance fleet emerged from hyperspace to take on the second, even more destructive Death Star. The galactic sky was filled with all manner of warships as this massive battle began. Unfortunately for the Rebel Alliance, Han Solo and his team were having difficulty knocking out the Death Star shield generator on the forest moon of Endor. With these shields still up, it was impossible for the Rebels to inflict serious damage on the orbiting battle station.
